summary: LFTD Partners Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary Lifted Liquids, Inc. (dba Lifted Made) closed the sale of the 5511 Building at 5511 95th Avenue, Kenosha, Wisconsin to Ad Real Estate Group LLC on September 29, 2026, under a Commercial Offer to Purchase executed July 22, 2026. The cash sale price was $1,500,000, set by arm's-length negotiation; the roughly 11,238 square-foot facility was purchased in December 2023 for $1,375,000 and served as the company's principal operations site. At closing, $841,109.63 of proceeds repaid the $910,000 Surety Bank building loan (10% fixed, December 2028 maturity), including a $9,100 prepayment penalty, releasing the first-priority mortgage and leaving no bank debt outstanding. The property was the company's only owned real estate. Watch for disclosure of post-sale leaseback or relocation arrangements, remaining liquidity, and whether operations shift without disruption to revenue.
